name: NovaBox uninitialised dividend checkpoints
summary: NovaBox adds new dual ETH/NOVA depositors to the dividend list without initialising their dividend checkpoints, and its extcodesize guard is bypassed from a constructor, so a fresh depositor could immediately withdraw and collect the whole stale historical ETH dividend.
notes: The direct NovaBox deployment installed the dividend-accounting runtime, which remained unchanged through the exploit.

Gross loss is the 56.942794338375078272 ETH paid above the attacker's 427.5 ETH campaign input. NovaBox's larger 65.022544338375078272 ETH balance decrease also includes 8.07975 ETH in transaction-generated owner fees sourced from that input, so those fees are not victim loss. The latest CoinGecko ETH observation before the transaction values the stolen ETH at $93,470.33.
